p: house in her first glory: For the people according as had been prophesied in Isa 2:2 and Eze 41:1-26, thought this temple should have been more excellent than Solomon's temple, which was destroyed by the Babylonians, but the Prophets meant the spiritual Temple, the Church of Christ.
work: That is, go forward in building the temple.

Yet once: He exhorts them to patience though they do not see as yet this temple so glorious as the Prophets had declared: for this should be accomplished in Christ, by whom all things should be renewed.
the desire of all nations shall: Meaning Christ, whom all ought to look for and desire: or by desire he may signify all precious things, such as riches, and things like them.

silver is mine: Therefore when his time comes he can make all the treasures of the world to serve his purpose: but the glory of this second Temple does not consist of material things, neither can it be built.
peace: Meaning all spiritual blessings and felicity purchased by Christ; Php 4:7.

holy flesh in the skirt of: That is, the flesh of the sacrifices, by which he means that a thing which of itself is good, cannot make another thing so: and therefore they ought not to justify themselves by their sacrifices and ceremonies: but contrary to this, he that is unclean and not pure of heart, does corrupt those things and make them detestable to God, which otherwise are good and godly.
day and upward: Consider how God plagued you with famine before you began to build the temple.
Since those days were: That is, before the building was begun.

this day and upward: From the time they began to build the temple, he promises that God would bless them: and even though the fruit has not yet come forth, yet in the gathering they would have plenty.
seed yet in the barn: He exhorts them to have patience, and to remain until the harvest came, and then they would see God's blessings.
will shake the heavens and the: I will make a change, and renew all things in Christ, of whom Zerubbabel is here a figure.
kingdoms of the heathen: By this he shows that there will be no stop or hindrance, when God will make this wonderful restitution of his Church.
signet: Signifying that his dignity would be most excellent, which thing was accomplished in Christ.
